content.text:
**Finding: missing (insurance clause absent)** — severity low, confidence 0.85.

- The Agreement has no insurance provision at all; a document-wide search for "insurance" returns no hits, and there is no insurance heading in the section outline.
- Insurance is nonetheless warranted: Garman installs the Software on Sparkling's AS400s at the Authorized Locations (§ 4(a)), performs future installations and conversions of Sparkling's data (§ 4(b)), and delivers on-site training and maintenance — i.e., a vendor that both touches our premises and processes our data.
- Redline (validated, ok:true): insert a new § 20(k) in General Matters, immediately after the entire-agreement subsection (p0149), requiring Garman to carry CGL of USD 1M per occurrence / USD 2M aggregate, E&O of USD 2M, cyber/privacy of USD 5M where it processes Sparkling's data, statutory workers' compensation, and to furnish certificates on request, for the term plus one year.
- Fallback flagged in the comment: E&O USD 1M and cyber USD 2M.
